rules.statement: A husband can claim double the value of maggar from his wife if she refuses to reconcile, provided a khula divorce has been granted or is pending.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this case the learned Commissioner seems to think that owing to the failure of the husband to follow all the provisions of sections 80-85 and fulfil the conditions therein, he is disentitled to exact double the value of the maggar under section 86. At the present time it is impossible to follow the provisions of these sections, for it is not possible to convene a meeting of 'priests,' 'commandants,' and 'officers of companies,' as required by those sections, to settle the difference of Muslim spouses."
